question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 Business Studies paper mein 23 questions hain. Q1 = 12 MCQ (12 marks). Q2 = 6 Fill blanks (6 marks). Q3 = 12 Very Short (1 mark each = 12 marks). Q4-Q16 = Short Answer (2 marks each = 26 marks). Q17-Q20 = Medium Answer (3 marks each = 12 marks). Q21-Q23 = Long Answer (4 marks each = 12 marks). Total = 80 marks.

tips: Q1-Q3 mein 30 marks hain — basic definitions aur concepts pakke karo. Sabse easy scoring section.
Q17 se Q23 mein OR choice milti hai — dono options padhkar jis par zyaada confident woh choose karo.
Section B mein chart-based questions aate hain (grapevine, formal communication, product classification) — inhe properly draw karo.
Long answers (Q21-Q23) mein numbered points likhna zyaada effective hai — 1, 2, 3, 4 points clearly.
Management aur Marketing dono parts se questions aate hain — dono cover karo.
SEBI, Consumer Protection Act, Financial Management ke facts pakke yaad karo — MCQ mein directly aate hain.
Fayol ke 14 principles mein se specific principles MCQ mein aate hain — Order aur Unity of Command pakka.
Roll number aur question number zaroor likho.
Multi-part questions ke sab parts ek saath continuity mein likhna compulsory hai.

time_allocation.note: 15 min — carefully attempt karo. Common sense + elimination method use karo.
20 min — Q2 ke 6 blanks + Q3 ke 12 sub-questions. One-line factual answers.
40 min — 3 min per question. 2 clear points. Chart questions mein neat diagram banao.
25 min — 6-7 min per question. 3 structured points.
30 min — 10 min each. 4 clear numbered points.
5 min — roll number, question numbers, word limits check karo

targets.strategy: Q1 MCQ (8-10 marks) + Q2 Fill blanks (4-5 marks) + Q3 very short (6-7 marks) + Q4-Q6 Section B (4-6 marks) = 22-28 marks.
focus_areas: Q1 MCQ — management = art+science, Fayol = mining engineer, planning = continuous, SEBI 1992, marketing mix = 4, consumer dispute = 3 tier, grapevine = gossip
Q2 fill blanks — planning = primary function, consumer = king, capital market = 2 parts, Jago Grahak Jago
Q3 — NSE full form, caveat emptor, decentralisation, procedure in planning, SEBI function
Q4-Q6 easy 2-mark questions from Management topics

targets.strategy: Section A full (28-30 marks) + Section B Q4-Q12 (14-16 marks) + Q17 ya Q18 (3 marks) = 45-49 marks.
focus_areas: Q4-Q6 characteristics of profession, Taylor mental revolution, external recruitment merits
Q7-Q9 management meaning, capital market vs money market, delegation vs decentralisation
Q17 primary vs secondary market OR Q18 demonetisation impact

targets.strategy: Section A (28-30) + Section B all (20-22 marks) + Section C Q17-Q19 (9 marks) + Q22 Section D (4 marks) = 61-65 marks.
focus_areas: Q17 primary vs secondary market 3 differences
Q18 training benefits to employees (3 points)
Q19 coordination OR planning process steps

targets.strategy: All 23 questions with structured 4-point answers in Section D. Charts clearly drawn. Bullet points se organized answers.
